title: Reviewer Judgment Actions
description: Actions used by the reviewer judgment framework.

entries.title: Compare Interpretations
entries.description: Compare each plausible reading before choosing one.

entries.title: Judge Sufficiency
entries.description: Decide whether the evidence is enough.

entries.title: Calibrate Confidence
entries.description: Set confidence according to the strength of support.

entries.title: Record Disagreement
entries.description: Record when experienced reviewers can reasonably disagree.

entries.title: Justify Narrative Outcome
entries.description: Explain when the story changes the reviewer outcome.
